description: Changes students suggested to their workouts (load, reps, exercise swap), waiting for the trainer by default: student name, workout, exercise, current and suggested values, the student's message and the app_url of the review screen filtered on that student. Use it to answer "who asked to change the workout?"; approve_workout_suggestion or reject_workout_suggestion only after the trainer says so. status "approved", "rejected" or "all" shows the history.
name: list_workout_suggestions
title: See students workout change requests
